project_type: Python FastAPI application for generating Schemes of Work and Lesson Plans
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py fixtures, in-memory SQLite, FastAPI TestClient
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest to verify all existing and new tests pass. 2. Run the seed script to populate data and generate .docx files in examples/. 3. Verify .docx files are created and non-empty.
snapshot_or_generated_files: examples/ directory will contain generated .docx files that should be committed as proof of output
setup_instructions: The .venv is already set up. Install python-docx: .venv/bin/pip install python-docx
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.12 with .venv already available.
contribution_requirements: Create a new branch from feat/fastapi-sow-generator, implement features, commit, push, create PR targeting feat/fastapi-sow-generator
key_patterns: Routers in app/routers/, services in app/services/, Pydantic schemas in app/schemas.py, ORM models in app/models.py. Tests use TestClient with db_session fixture. APIs at /api/ prefix. Services accept (syllabus_id, calendar_id, db) and return Pydantic response models.
directory_structure: app/ (main app code), app/routers/ (API endpoints), app/services/ (business logic), tests/ (pytest), tools/_extracted/ (text extractions from PDF/DOCX assets), assets/ (original PDF/DOCX files)
